column1: # How the 431 genomes of the extended reference set were chosen, from the 454 dereplicated
# representatives of the mashID Brucella pack's source collection (figshare article 33970168, version 4;
# 2,022 NCBI taxon-234 assemblies, dereplicated at a MASH distance of 0.0003).
# Validated on simulated reads of all 2,022 assemblies: 1544/1544 held-out samples of a named species
# right once the seven mislabelled truth genomes below are accounted for (wiki, Validation).
# Every genome not listed here was kept as it was.
# The DROP-SP cutoff of 0.004 was set on the classical species and does not transfer: it dropped three
# genomes that are not twins at all. GCA_000163135.1 is B. papionis (now a RELABEL), and
# GCA_030157885.1 and GCA_000370945.1 are distinct unnamed lineages, outside the diversity of the
# species they were said to duplicate, so both are kept. curation/mislabelled_records.md shows the
# measurements. A genome is a twin here only when it sits inside its neighbour species' own spread.
# The records whose label the sequence contradicts are tracked, with the evidence for each, in
# curation/mislabelled_records.md, so they can be reported to the submitters and to NCBI.
